summary: Phase 1 SEALED: npu_top integrates CSR + DMA + TCM behind one AXI4-Lite slave (CSR@0x3000 / TCM@0x3001 decode); DMA streams shared-mem weights into TCM; level IRQ to host on completion (assert + CTRL clear). Freeze guard gate_10_host_noregress enforces design/cpu_m1/rtl byte-identity to m1a-rtl-freeze-v1.0. Verilator lint 0-error + iverilog NPU_TOP_PASS (23 checks). 13/13 gate tests green.
note: Phase 1 closed. npu_top is the stable socket for the Phase 2 cpu_m1-derived NPU core. Open (Phase 2+): NPU scalar+F core, RVV Zve32x EXU, GEMV 64->256, ML e2e; plus optional double-buffer/multi-outstanding throughput tuning.
